title: Layers, Adjustments & Non-Destructive Blend Modes
tagline: Master multi-layer compositing, real-time shader adjustments, and blend mode mathematics.
description: Understand the non-destructive layer stack of Affinity Photo 3.0: Pixel vs Image layers, child clipping masks, Adjustment layers (Curves, Levels, HSL, B&W), Live Filters, and the exact mathematics behind Multiply, Screen, Overlay, and Color Dodge blend modes.

starterAsset.statusNote: Technical practice guide for layer types, clipping adjustments and blend modes in Affinity Photo.
